concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading sentiment scores from the HuggingFace dataset `snap-cornell/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-dataset`. The task list implements sentiment ingestion via the GDELT API (T018) and never creates a task to download or process the required HuggingFace dataset, thereby weakening the functional requirement.

FR-001 and FR-002 mandate quarterly‑frequency time‑series. All user‑story tasks (e.g., T019, T026‑T034) explicitly operate on a **monthly** frequency, citing a “methodological correction” in the plan. This overrides the spec without an explicit amendment, constituting a retroactive narrowing of the functional requirement.

Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires per‑file checksums recorded in the project state. Task T006 computes a single SHA‑256 hash for the whole repository but does not generate or store individual checksums for each raw data file, leaving the constitution partially unfulfilled.

SC‑005 expects the final report to include all dataset URLs and DOIs. Task T043 only says “update documentation” without specifying that these citations be added, risking omission of required provenance information.

Reproducibility (Principle I) requires that API credentials be read from a `.env` file. Task T007 creates only a `.env.example` placeholder and no task ensures that a real `.env` (populated with the required keys) is generated or documented, breaking the reproducibility guarantee.
